description: This file defines the UsersLastImport class, a PHP class representing the 'users_last_import' table in SuiteCRM, extending SugarBean. It manages user import records, including functionalities like undoing imports and marking records as deleted.

classes.name: UsersLastImport
classes.description: Bean class for the 'users_last_import' table, managing user import history and related operations within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: listviewACLHelper
methods.description: Extends access control helper, adding support for Accounts module based on permissions.

methods.name: mark_deleted_by_user_id
methods.description: Deletes all import records associated with a specific user ID.

methods.name: undoById
methods.description: Undoes a specific import record by ID for the current user.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Undoes all import records for a specific module for the current user.

methods.name: _deleteRecord
methods.description: Deletes a bean record and its related email addresses and custom fields.

methods.name: getBeansByImport
methods.description: Returns distinct bean types for imports done by the current user in a specific module.
